title: Non-Fungible frens
tagline: My main aim is to build a decentralized social media and NFT marketplace ,where creators get rewarded via tokens for participation.
description:
My main aim is to build a decentralized social media and NFT marketplace ,where creators get rewarded via tokens for participation. I believe artists and creatives in the nft space should be rewarded for participation apart from the regular shilling.  This will serve as an incentive to encourage people.
I was only able to create the Ui because I didn’t find other team members.
how_its_made:
I did the design framework on figma and consulted other Nfts marketplaces to see what hat they lack and how I can change that in my design.
My major technology was figma.
I’m still working on the design but I wasn’t able to use the Zora api because I don’t have any knowledge on how to implement it.
